Track 04 · DSA · C++

Basic Data Structures
& Algorithms (C++)

A rigorous, problem-solving-focused curriculum using C++. Solve 5 LeetCode/Codeforces problems every day, covering all foundational DSA topics from arrays and sorting to linked lists and recursion over 40 days.

40 Days · 8 Weeks
200 Problems Total
C Block · Programming Lab
9:30 AM – 2:30 PM Daily

8-Week Curriculum

Week 01
C++ Fundamentals
  • C++ setup: GCC/G++, VS Code, competitive programming config
  • Variables, data types, operators, I/O
  • Loops, functions, arrays (1D & 2D)
  • Pointers, references, dynamic memory · std::string
  • Recursion, GCD/LCM, primes, sieve of Eratosthenes
Outcome: Write, debug & submit C++ programs on online judges with confidence.
Week 02
Complexity Analysis & STL
  • Big-O, Big-Omega & Big-Theta notation
  • Best, average & worst-case analysis
  • STL containers: vector, map, set, queue, stack
  • STL algorithms & iterators
Outcome: Analyze complexity and select the most suitable STL container or algorithm.
Week 03
Bit Manipulation & Arrays / Sorting
  • Binary representation & bitwise operators
  • XOR tricks, bit shifting & masking
  • Prefix sums & difference arrays
  • Sorting algorithms: bubble, merge, quick, counting sort
Outcome: Solve array, bit manipulation and sorting problems using optimized C++ approaches.
Week 04
Sliding Window & Two Pointers
  • Fixed-size & variable-size sliding windows
  • Complexity improvement from O(nk) to O(n)
  • Opposite-end & fast-slow pointer patterns
  • Subarray and substring problems
Outcome: Recognize and apply linear-time techniques for subarray, substring and pointer-based problems.
Week 05
Binary Search & Strings
  • Binary search template & rotated sorted arrays
  • Binary search on answer
  • String manipulation: KMP, Z-algorithm
  • Pattern matching techniques
Outcome: Solve search and string problems using optimized pattern-matching and binary search techniques.
Week 06
Stack & Queue
  • Stack ADT: implementation & valid-parentheses pattern
  • Monotonic stack patterns
  • Queue ADT & deque-based optimization
  • Simulation & scheduling problems
Outcome: Apply stack, queue and deque patterns to solve simulation, monotonic and scheduling problems.
Week 07
Linked Lists & Recursion / Backtracking
  • Singly linked list: traversal, insertion, deletion, reversal
  • Fast-slow pointer in linked lists
  • Recursion structured templates
  • Backtracking introduction · recursive DFS preview
Outcome: Solve linked list, recursion and backtracking problems using structured templates.
Week 08
Contest Review & Interview Prep
  • Comprehensive review: arrays, sorting, prefix sum, sliding window
  • Review: binary search, strings, stack, deque, trie
  • Mock contest: timed problem-solving under pressure
  • Interview Q&A sessions & confidence building
Outcome: Contest-level confidence for coding rounds and technical interviews.
🏅

Internship Completion Certificate

Issued by Geeta Technical Hub upon completing 200 problems, maintaining a problem log, and demonstrating consistent daily practice.

Track 05 · DSA · Advanced

Advanced Data Structures
& Algorithms

For students ready to tackle complex algorithmic problems. Go deep into trees, graphs, dynamic programming, segment trees, and advanced competitive programming techniques — preparation for top-tier coding interviews.

40 Days · 8 Weeks
LeetCode · Codeforces
C Block

8-Week Curriculum

Week 01
Advanced Recursion & Trees
  • Recursion patterns: divide and conquer
  • Binary trees: traversal, height, diameter
  • BST operations & validation
  • Tree-based problem templates
Outcome: Apply structured recursion and tree traversal to solve complex hierarchical problems.
Week 02
Heaps, Tries & Advanced STL
  • Priority queues & heap operations
  • Trie data structure: insert, search, prefix matching
  • Advanced STL: multiset, priority_queue, ordered_set
  • Greedy algorithms with heaps
Outcome: Solve priority-based, prefix-matching and greedy problems using advanced data structures.
Week 03
Graphs — BFS, DFS & Shortest Paths
  • Graph representations: adjacency list & matrix
  • BFS & DFS traversals
  • Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford & Floyd-Warshall
  • Topological sort & cycle detection
Outcome: Model and solve graph-based problems using appropriate traversal and shortest-path algorithms.
Week 04
Advanced Graphs — MST, Union-Find & SCC
  • Minimum Spanning Tree: Kruskal & Prim
  • Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find)
  • Strongly Connected Components
  • Bridges, articulation points
Outcome: Solve advanced graph connectivity and optimization problems with confidence.
Week 05
Dynamic Programming I
  • DP fundamentals: memoization & tabulation
  • 1D DP: Fibonacci, climbing stairs, house robber
  • 2D DP: longest common subsequence, edit distance
  • Knapsack problem variants
Outcome: Identify and solve classic DP patterns using both top-down and bottom-up approaches.
Week 06
Dynamic Programming II — Advanced Patterns
  • Interval DP & partition DP
  • Bitmask DP
  • DP on trees & graphs
  • Optimization: space-reduced DP techniques
Outcome: Tackle complex DP problems including interval, bitmask and tree-based variants.
Week 07
Segment Trees & Advanced Techniques
  • Segment tree: build, query & update
  • Lazy propagation
  • Fenwick tree (Binary Indexed Tree)
  • Sparse table & range queries
Outcome: Solve range-query problems efficiently using segment trees and Fenwick trees.
Week 08
Contest Simulation & Interview Mastery
  • Full-length mock contests (Codeforces Div. 2 format)
  • Comprehensive review of all advanced topics
  • Speed optimization & template usage
  • Technical interview Q&A & feedback sessions
Outcome: Compete confidently at Codeforces Div. 2 level and crack DSA-heavy technical interviews.
🏅

Internship Completion Certificate

Issued by Geeta Technical Hub upon completing all weekly problem sets, mock contests, and demonstrating consistent upsolving practice.

Advanced Visualization — Matplotlib & Seaborn

Case Study — Weather Dataset Time-Series Analysis

Group Project & Final Presentation
